parsed.name: 电化学恒电位仪
parsed.description: 这是一种用于电化学实验的恒电位仪，可在测量过程中控制或扫描电位，并采集电流、电压及其随时间变化的数据。它常用于电化学表征、极化测试和其他需要实时观察电流-电压响应的实验。
parsed.description_en: This is a potentiostat for electrochemical experiments. It controls or scans electrode potential during a measurement and acquires current, voltage, and time-dependent signals. It is commonly used for electrochemical characterization, polarization tests, and other experiments that require live monitoring of current-voltage behavior.
